name: Token of Thievery
summary: At Alther's Mill, Lucius puts rogue initiates to a dangerous test. They must recover the Token of Thievery from a locked footlocker among the ruins.

sections.title: A Test of Finesse
sections.body: Lucius tests promising rogues in the field from Lakeshire. Among the ruins of Alther's Mill, he hides the Token of Thievery in a locked footlocker. Blackrock orcs threaten the area, making each attempt a test of lockpicking under mortal danger. Success earns a Certificate of Thievery.

faq.q: What is the Token of Thievery?
faq.answer: At Alther's Mill, Lucius locks the Token of Thievery in a footlocker. Rogue initiates must pick its lock in danger to prove their skill.

faq.q: Who puts the token in the lockbox?
faq.answer: Lucius, an experienced rogue mentor in Lakeshire, puts the token in the footlocker to train young rogues.

faq.q: Why is the chest placed at Alther's Mill?
faq.answer: Alther's Mill lies up the road from Lakeshire, where Blackrock orcs prowl. Lucius sends trainees there to pick locks quickly and quietly in hostile territory.

faq.q: What do you receive in exchange for the token?
faq.answer: Return the token to Lucius, and you earn a Certificate of Thievery that recognizes your foundational lockpicking training.

angles.text: As a rogue, you prove your lockpicking skill by recovering the Token of Thievery from ruins threatened by Blackrock orcs.
